 Order
% 08.08.2025 CM Appl. 48869/2025[Seeking condonation of delay]
1. This is an Application filed on behalf of the Appellant seeking condonation of delay of 48 days in re-filing the present Appeal.
2. For the reasons as stated in the Application, the delay is condoned.
3. The Application stands disposed of.
CM Appl. 48868/2025[Exemption from filing dim annexures]

4. Allowed, subject to the Appellant filing certified copies of the dim annexures within a period of three weeks.
5.
The Application stands disposed of.
MAC.APP. 495/2025 & CM Appl. 48867/2025[Stay]

6. The present Appeal has been filed under Section 173 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 impugning the award dated 14.02.2025 passed by the learned Presiding Officer, MACT, North West, Rohini Courts,
Delhi [hereinafter referred to as "Impugned Award"].

challenging the same award, being MAC.APP.493/2025 captioned Liberty General Insurance Ltd v.

sentences.text: 8. Issue Notice.
On steps being taken, let Notice be issued to the Respondents via all modes.
An affidavit of service be filed within a week.
9. Subject to the deposit of entire decretal amount inclusive of up-to-date interest within a period of 6 weeks, the operation of the Impugned Award shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
In the event, there is any default in depositing the amount, the interim protection granted by this Court shall automatically stand vacated.

9.1 Upon deposit by the Appellant, 50% of the deposited amount inclusive of up-to-date interest shall be released to the Respondents/Claimants in accordance with scheme, as is set out in the Impugned Award.

10. Accordingly, list along MAC. APP. 493/2025 before the concerned Registrar on 30.10.2025.
11.
The parties will act based on the digitally signed copy of the order.
TARA VITASTA GANJU, J AUGUST 8, 2025/r
